title: Grafana Observability

mcp.title: Grafana MCP connection
mcp.subtitle: Point this page at one MCP endpoint; metrics, logs and traces are read from it.
mcp.argsHint: One argument per line, e.g. run -i --rm mcp/grafana -t stdio
mcp.headersHint: One Name: Value per line, e.g. Authorization: Bearer <token>; leave empty to send none
mcp.serverNameHint: Display name and tool prefix: 1-32 letters, digits, underscores or dashes
mcp.help: Settings are stored in the Host storages directory; the token only travels over the local page and local disk.
monitor.emptyNoService: Pick a service to chart CPU and memory.
monitor.emptyNoTool: The MCP server exposes no Prometheus query tool, so metrics cannot be read.
logs.emptyHint: Try another service or range, or just ask below.
traces.emptyHint: Try another service or range, or just ask below.
chat.title: Ask with chat
chat.placeholder: One question, e.g. which error logs appeared in the last 15 minutes?
chat.hint: The default model answers from MCP tool results; fetched rows also land in the list above.
chat.needConnect: Connect Grafana MCP on the right first.
status.noTool: The server misses a required tool
status.grafanaAuth: Grafana rejected the MCP server's token (invalid or expired)
status.noModel: No default model is available, so MCP tools were called directly.
status.connectHint: Configure and connect Grafana MCP from the top right to load data.
